title: Natural, Whole, Integers and Rational Numbers
subject: Mathematics
objective: Each new family of numbers answers a question the old one could not, and every family lives inside the next: N ⊂ W ⊂ Z ⊂ Q.

fill.q: Whole numbers are natural numbers together with ____.
Integers include negative numbers, zero and ____ numbers.
A rational number is p/q where p, q are integers and q ≠ ____.

tf.q: Every integer is a rational number.

ar.a: Every integer is a rational number.
ar.r: Any integer n can be written as n/1.

ar.explain: A is false; R is true.

mcq.q: Which is a whole number but not natural?
The correct order of sets is:

mcq.explain: It is an integer and rational.

short.q: Write N, W, Z and Q and show how they are related.

short.solution: 0 = 0/1, so it is rational. 5/0 is not a number because division by zero is undefined.

match.explain: Each family adds numbers the previous one lacked.
